carla_pm: Following up on the postmortem action list. Need explicit owners, Jira links, and due dates so we can close the loop. Please ack and add any missing sub-tasks. Master tracker: https://redwood.app/pm/trackers/RED-INC-2026

ben_g: Ack. I'll take the rollback automation and the import e2e subtask. Will create tickets now.

dmitri_sre: I'll own the cache eviction alerting + runbook, and do a quick RCA writeup on recurring cache pressure after bulk imports. ETA for initial runbook: 2026-03-14.

alice_w: I will update the oncall handoff playbook and coordinate a quick 20m sync with oncall. Tentative due 2026-03-10.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall handover window Tue 2026-03-09 09:00 UTC. Use /handover to attach ticket links.

ben_g: Created RED-4071 for rollback automation, linked to the postmortem, assignee ben_g, due 2026-03-12. Subtask RED-4072 for import e2e tests, due 2026-03-18. Commands used:
jira create --project RED --summary "gen-serve: automate rollback" --assignee ben_g --due 2026-03-12 --labels postmortem
jira create --project RED --summary "e2e: import pipeline" --assignee ben_g --due 2026-03-18 --parent RED-4071

carla_pm: Good. Please include this RACI blurb in each ticket description: Responsible={owner}, Accountable=carla_pm, Consulted=sre/eng, Informed=support/docs. Add the postmortem link and the master tracker.

dmitri_sre: Opening RED-4080 for cache alerting + runbook. I'll add an RFC note about recurring patterns and link it. Setting due 2026-03-15.

alice_w: Added RED-4090 for handoff/playbook updates and scheduled a 20m sync Mon 2026-03-08 16:00 UTC. Invited ops-oncall, ben_g, and dmitri_sre.

ben_g: Linking tickets in tracker now. Tracker updated.

carla_pm: :thumbsup: Thanks. Closing criteria for this thread: 1) tickets created with owners and due dates 2) tracker updated 3) handoff sync scheduled. I'll do a one-week check-in and reopen thread if timelines slip or if the RCA shows a larger recurring issue.

dmitri_sre: FYI, initial RCA shows two prior incidents with a similar cache-growth signature. I'll include a short appendix in the RFC with timestamps and links.

alice_w: Ack. I'll include playbook snippet for cache-pressure mitigation and escalation steps.

ben_g: One ask: if deadlines need to slide, let's call a prioritization review in #eng-sre to decide trade-offs.

carla_pm: Agreed. Thanks everyone. I'll mark the action items in the master tracker as pending and post the 1-week check-in date.
